problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct in-person visits to five distinct corporate offices.

The travel durations between offices are recorded in minutes:
* Office Alpha to Beta: 63.4 minutes
* Office Alpha to Gamma: 40.6 minutes
* Office Alpha to Delta: 90.4 minutes
* Office Alpha to Epsilon: 66.0 minutes
* Office Beta to Gamma: 103.3 minutes
* Office Beta to Delta: 153.8 minutes
* Office Beta to Epsilon: 116.7 minutes
* Office Gamma to Delta: 52.9 minutes
* Office Gamma to Epsilon: 41.6 minutes
* Office Delta to Epsilon: 74.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the itinerary of minimal total duration that allows the representative to visit each office precisely once, commencing and concluding at the initial office location.
